name: Retreat at Brighton Ridge Homes
headline: The Retreat at Brighton Ridge is a 264-home, all-60%-AMI family apartment community by Pedcor Investments on Lot 2 of Brighton Ridge Filing 1 near 120th Avenue and Potomac Street in Brighton (now addressed 560 Gateway St); it won $4,758,924 a year in 2022 federal 4% credit, the largest of this group, with $51.2M of CHFA bonds.
why_it_matters: A large garden-style 60% AMI deal by an out-of-state tax credit developer that bought its land in mid-2023 and now markets the property, but with almost no public record of local approvals, financing partners or construction dates.

status.label: Marketed for lease by Pedcor; no dated construction or completion record found; 8609s not yet issued
status.detail: Pedcor bought the land in June 2023 and moved it to its project partnership in July 2024; the City of Brighton's address layer now lists eight residential buildings and four garage buildings at 560 Gateway St, and Pedcor's leasing site markets the community (viewed 2026-10-21). No permit, certificate of occupancy or opening date was found, and CHFA still lists the deal on its 2026-09-21 award report, which excludes developments with 8609s issued.

next_step: Look for City of Brighton building permit and certificate of occupancy records for 560 Gateway St and for 8609 issuance.

background.text: Pedcor Investments LLC bought Lot 2 from Walk Off LLC by special warranty deed dated 2023-06-01 (recorded 2023-06-02) for $2,596,076, then deeded it to Pedcor Investments-2021-CLXXXIV LP on 2024-07-01 (recorded 2024-07-18) for a recorded $639,417; the partnership transfer likely coincided with the financing closing (inferred).

The City of Brighton rezoned about 17.7 acres around the site to R-3 by Ordinance 2388 on 2022-08-02, and its development phasing layer lists Brighton Ridge Filing 1 with a development agreement and a partial assignment (inferred to be the local approvals behind the project).
The city's address layer shows site addresses for buildings 1 to 8 and garages G1 to G4 at 560 Gateway St, plus individual unit addresses; it does not by itself prove the units are occupied.
The deal does not appear in CHFA's 2022 Round One or Round Two competitive application narratives; it was a rolling 4% bond deal only.

CHFA's 4% award report says it leaves out developments whose IRS Form 8609s have been issued; this deal is still listed on the 2026-09-21 report, so 8609s had not been issued by then (inferred from the report's note).
